components.name: Program collision polynomial and depth-shell birth decomposition
components.project_addition: Shows that the full W_k hierarchy at fixed readout depth is exactly equivalent by binomial inversion to the unlabeled short-program multiplicity histogram, and that depth-shell collision birth requires the stronger joint transition histogram (previous multiplicity, new-shell multiplicity).
components.prior_boundary: Binomial inversion and Vandermonde identities are elementary prior mathematics.
